title: A Hot Monday
setting: A sunny outdoor cafe on a summer day.

characters.name: Sara
characters.look: Sara, a girl with long brown hair and a white shirt

characters.name: Ivan
characters.look: Ivan, a boy with short black hair and a blue T-shirt

sentences.en: It is the last Monday in July.
sentences.zh: 今天是七月的最后一个星期一。
sentences.scene_prompt: A sunny outdoor cafe with small tables and umbrellas on a hot summer morning.

sentences.en: Sara finds a seat at the cafe.
sentences.zh: 萨拉在咖啡馆找到一个座位。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara, a girl with long brown hair and a white shirt looks at an empty chair at a table in the sunny outdoor cafe.

sentences.en: She sits down with a purple cup.
sentences.zh: 她拿着一个紫色杯子坐下。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara, a girl with long brown hair and a white shirt sits at a cafe table holding a purple cup.

sentences.en: Ivan comes in and says hello to her.
sentences.zh: 伊万走进来，跟她打招呼。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ivan, a boy with short black hair and a blue T-shirt walks into the cafe and waves hello to Sara, a girl with long brown hair and a white shirt at her table.

sentences.en: He opens the top of his water bottle.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ivan, a boy with short black hair and a blue T-shirt twists open the top of his water bottle next to Sara, a girl with long brown hair and a white shirt.

sentences.en: Sadly, there is zero water inside.
sentences.zh: 可惜，瓶子里一点水也没有。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ivan, a boy with short black hair and a blue T-shirt looks sadly into his empty water bottle, holding it upside down.

sentences.en: “Help yourself to my water,” says Sara.
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara, a girl with long brown hair and a white shirt smiles and pushes a jug of water toward Ivan, a boy with short black hair and a blue T-shirt.

sentences.en: Ivan thanks her again and wants nothing else.
sentences.zh: 伊万再次谢谢她，别的什么都不要了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ivan, a boy with short black hair and a blue T-shirt happily drinks from his full bottle and smiles at Sara, a girl with long brown hair and a white shirt again.
